adoption.label: MPP named payment methods
adoption.one: Cards, stablecoins and Lightning are listed. There is still no bank debit method.

adoption.one: From 1,874 payers to 92 payees. Card based MPP runs off chain, uncounted.

adoption.label: Agent activity reaching checkout pages
adoption.one: Most agent visits land on product and search pages, not checkout.

adoption.label: Amazon blocks named AI agents
adoption.one: Amazon's robots.txt bars named agents from Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity.

adoption.label: European banks in controlled live Agent Pay tests
adoption.one: Mastercard's footnote names 36 banks. Pilot, not public.

adoption.label: Personal agents paying with Shop Pay
adoption.one: Muse, Claude Duet and Instinct pay with network tokens. The agent never sees the card.

adoption.label: Comfortable with AI buying for them
adoption.one: Kantar is the only neutral firm in the survey set.

adoption.label: Shopify AI search orders, year on year
adoption.one: Shopify says the volume is still small. Base level not disclosed.

adoption.label: Visa AI partners live
adoption.one: Visa calls agentic volume limited and very small, with Ramp bill pay generally available.

adoption.label: Trust AI to make a payment
adoption.one: Visa sponsored the poll. It gains if trust attaches to networks.

adoption.label: Alipay AI Pay, one week
adoption.one: Largest reported base, outside Western protocols. Every payment needs user approval.

adoption.label: Transactions merchants say involve agents
adoption.one: Merchant estimate, UK and US, no method given.

adoption.label: US ecommerce orders completed by agents
adoption.one: A modeled panel from an SEO agency. Up from 0.27 percent in Q2.

adoption.label: Agent completed orders inside three platforms
adoption.one: Meta Muse, Alexa for Shopping and Gemini. ChatGPT refers more than it completes.

companies.name: Mastercard
companies.one: Wants the agentic token, not a one time virtual card, inside every agent.
companies.arch: Agent keys in a network directory via Web Bot Auth, Verifiable Intent SD-JWT chains, agentic tokens with passkeys, and an agent transaction score in testing.

moves.text: All European issuers enabled, 36 banks completed controlled live agent transactions
Began a know your agent framework with Ant and Visa
Expanded Agent Pay, agent probability score in US testing
OpenAI deal includes Agent Pay, and Shop Pay uses Agent Pay

companies.watch: Network rules on virtual cards, and OpenAI checkout on Agent Pay.

companies.name: Visa
companies.one: Wants to be the trust layer every agent protocol routes through, consumer and B2B.
companies.arch: Trusted Agent Protocol signs agent requests under RFC 9421. Intelligent Commerce provisions agentic tokens after a passkey and purchase instruction. Connect accepts TAP, MPP, ACP and UCP.

moves.text: Live B2B pilot with BILL and Billtrust paying invoices
Rules make cardholders answer for their enrolled agents
Says nearly 50 AI partners live, volume still very small
Benchmark finds 57.2 percent pass rate across 22 models

companies.watch: Partner count doubling, and a published dispute path for agents.
companies.rank_note: Tied with Google at 380. Ties break on the score with vendor reach cut, where Visa leads 340 to 320, then on the token layer.

companies.name: Google
companies.one: Co-develops UCP and wrote AP2. Wants Search and Gemini to be where agents shop.
companies.arch: UCP covers discovery and checkout over REST, MCP and A2A. AP2 adds SD-JWT mandates. Merchants stay merchant of record.

moves.text: UCP published with Shopify, PayPal support the same day
Universal Cart begins US rollout with UCP checkout
Says UCP reaches hundreds of thousands of brands, adding AP2

companies.watch: AP2 folded into a UCP release, and any disclosed checkout volume.
companies.rank_note: Tied with Visa at 380. Ties break on the score with vendor reach cut, where Visa leads 340 to 320, then on the token layer.

startups.arch: Agent Control Layer enforces agent and program limits at card issuance and transfer start. Beta. No protocol of its own.

Launched the Agentic Payments Alliance with 26 founding members

startups.name: Skyfire

startups.arch: KYAPay JWTs carry agent, platform and human principal claims from a trusted issuer. Individual draft, no working group standing. Stablecoin settlement.

moves.text: KYAPay draft 01 published at the IETF
KYAPay draft 02, same three authors, expires 2027-05-06

startups.watch: The Ant, Mastercard and Visa KYA framework could make it redundant.

funding.text: 9.5 million USD in total, last verified round October 2024

startups.name: Crossmint
startups.one: A self serve agent checkout toolkit that rides Visa and Mastercard agentic tokens.
startups.arch: Uses Visa Intelligent Commerce and Mastercard Agent Pay tokens where a card is eligible. Checks out through UCP, Shop Pay or browser automation.

moves.text: Founding member of the Agentic Payments Alliance
Agent Commerce Toolkit goes live and self serve

scenarios.name: Network tokens, open checkout
scenarios.one: Agentic network tokens pay, and open protocols carry checkout across many agent platforms.
scenarios.arch: Kill test: three platforms still hold over half of agent orders at 2027-12-31. Thesis wins: canonical model plus adapters.

by.2027: Top three platforms fall below half of agent orders
by.2028: Networks ship an agent flag and dispute rule
by.2030: Most agent checkouts ride agentic tokens on open protocols

signals: Vendor panel: top three platforms below half
EMVCo or a network adds an agent flag

scenarios.name: Platform wallets own checkout
scenarios.one: Agents pay inside the wallet and checkout of the platform they live in.
scenarios.arch: The lead case today. Kill test: top three platforms below half for two quarters. Thesis loses: integrate those platforms directly.

by.2027: Three platforms still hold most agent completed orders
by.2028: Merchants pay platform fees to reach agent shoppers
by.2030: A few wallets carry most consumer agent payments

signals: Amazon still blocks named outside shopping agents
Platforms charge merchants fees on agent sales

scenarios.name: Agents refer, people pay
scenarios.one: Agents find and compare, then people check out on the merchant's own site.
scenarios.arch: Kill test: your own agent completed share passes the trigger for two months. Thesis holds: wait with readiness, never build the gateway.

by.2027: Agent completed orders stay a small share of orders
by.2028: AI referrals keep growing, checkout stays on merchant sites
by.2030: Agents shape demand, people still press pay

signals: Your agent order share stays below the trigger
Holiday reports count referral clicks, not agent payments

scenarios.one: Pay per call moves to stablecoin rails over HTTP 402, apart from card checkout.
scenarios.arch: Kill test: screened agentic x402 value below a million USD a month at end 2027. Separate lane, settled through a facilitator.

by.2027: Stablecoin issuer rule in force in the US
by.2028: Organic payers grow beyond a few thousand wallets
by.2030: API, data and content sellers price per call by default
